name: keyence_brightfield_profile
title: Keyence All-in-One Brightfield Stitching Preset
description: Keyence BZ-X .bcf tile-scans: stage model measured from neighbouring tiles, coordinate placement, ghost QC (AXIO >= 1.3)

microscope.metadata_format: .bcf (ZIP archive containing XML properties and FileList)

colour_brightfield_tiles.note: RGB, e.g. ALP / ARS stain scans

stitching_parameters.y_axis_orientation: inverted (stage coordinate Y aligns with image matrix row)
stitching_parameters.correction_note: Phase-contrast tiles are stitched uncorrected. For colour stain scans use correction='median'; tile names must then be relative to the tile directory (AXIO >= 1.3 enforces it).

stage_model.method: phase correlation of neighbour chains along 4 rows (both parities) and 2 columns, trimmed least squares; cached per dataset
stage_model.do_not_use: the scan-region corner points (EdgePoint0..3): on BZ-X stages their step is ~2.3 % short in x (1.0 % for 50-column scans) - keyence_step='edgepoints' reproduces AXIO 1.2.x for comparison only

full_resolution_mosaic.description: Full uncompressed/lossless ~4.9 Gigapixel mosaic for Fiji Bio-Formats (virtual stack), QuPath, Napari, ASAP

imagej_overview.description: Downsampled <4GB overview for direct drag-and-drop viewing in standard ImageJ without plugins

preview_thumbnail.description: High resolution thumbnail for rapid visual QC

reproducible_cli_command: python -m axio_stitching.cli stitch --source "<INPUT_FOLDER>" --out-dir "<OUTPUT_FOLDER>"  # auto: correction none, algorithm coordinate, measured keyence_step

reproducible_python_api.code:
from pathlib import Path
from axio_stitching.models import StitchConfig
from axio_stitching.engine import StitchingEngine

config = StitchConfig(
    source=Path(r'<INPUT_FOLDER>'),
    out_dir=Path(r'<OUTPUT_FOLDER>'),
    # correction/algorithm 'auto' -> none/coordinate for Keyence; keyence_step 'auto' measures the step
)
result = StitchingEngine(config).run()
print(result.run_manifest)

quality_control.pass_rule: ghost_excess_x and ghost_excess_y < 0.05 (>= 0.15 = double image at ghost_lag_* px)
quality_control.note: the seam-prominence metric cannot see a wrong tile step; read the ghost metrics
